newsitem.title: USA: U.S. funds record inflow in 3-day period -- survey.
newsitem.headline: U.S. funds record inflow in 3-day period -- survey.

text.p: U.S. mutual funds recorded cash inflows of $675 million for the three-day period ended December 19, versus outflows of $145 million for the two-day period ended December 16, according to Mutual Fund Trim Tabs.
The fund-tracking firm said international funds posted inflows of $228 million versus outflows of $23 million.

Aggressive growth funds had inflows of $639 million versus outflows of $181 million, equity income funds had inflows of $129 million versus inflows of $4 million, and growth and income funds saw a drop in inflows to $98 million from $188 million.

Bond funds recorded outflows of $483 million versus inflows of $118 million. Government/GNMA funds had outflows of $154 million versus outflows of $27 million, and muni funds had outflows of $280 million versus inflows of $133 million.
